# PNG to SVG Free

> PNG to SVG Free (pngtosvgfree.com) is a free online PNG to SVG converter that turns PNG, JPG and WEBP images into clean, scalable vectors right in your browser. No signup, no watermark, no upload — images are traced locally with WebAssembly.

## Key facts

- Price: free, no account, no watermark, no daily limits.
- Input formats (6): PNG, JPG/JPEG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, AVIF. Output: standard SVG.
- Privacy: conversion runs entirely in the browser; files are never uploaded or stored.
- File size: no limit; images are traced at up to 1,700 px on the longest edge (High quality).
- Image types with tuned presets: Logo / Clip art, Photograph, Sketch / B&W, Silhouette (single colour for cutting).
- Controls: 1–32 colours, suggested palettes (2–16), recolour or remove any colour, detail, noise smoothing, speckle removal (1–64 px), corner angle (20–120°), quality presets, registration marks for layered cuts.
- Output works with Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Studio (Designer Edition+), LightBurn, Glowforge, Figma, Illustrator, Inkscape and Canva.
- One image is converted at a time. A separate free tool converts SVG to PNG in bulk.
- Tracing engine: WebAssembly build of the open-source VTracer engine with automatic image-type detection and k-means colour quantization.

## Tools

- [PNG to SVG Converter](https://pngtosvgfree.com/): Convert PNG, JPG and WEBP images to SVG vectors free online. Auto tracing, colour control, no signup, no watermark and files never leave your browser.
- [JPG to SVG Converter — Free & Online](https://pngtosvgfree.com/jpg-to-svg): Convert JPG images to clean SVG vectors free online. Removes JPEG compression noise, lets you remove the background and runs privately in your browser.
- [JPEG to SVG Converter Online, Free](https://pngtosvgfree.com/jpeg-to-svg): Turn JPEG files into editable SVG vectors free. Smart colour detection, adjustable detail and background removal — processed privately in your browser.
- [WEBP to SVG Converter — Free Online](https://pngtosvgfree.com/webp-to-svg): Convert WEBP images to SVG vectors for free. Keeps transparency, auto-detects colours and traces logos and graphics privately in your browser, no signup.
- [Image to SVG Converter — Vectorize Images Free](https://pngtosvgfree.com/image-to-svg): Vectorize any image online: convert PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, BMP or AVIF to SVG free. Automatic tracing, colour control, no signup and no upload to a server.
- [Logo to SVG Converter — Free Vector Logo Online](https://pngtosvgfree.com/logo-to-svg): Convert a PNG or JPG logo to a clean SVG vector free. Sharp corners, exact brand colours, transparent background — no Illustrator, no signup, no upload.
- [PNG to SVG for Cricut — Free Cut File Converter](https://pngtosvgfree.com/png-to-svg-cricut): Convert PNG images into Cricut-ready SVG cut files free. Layered by colour, single-colour Silhouette mode, transparent background and no upload or signup.
- [PNG to SVG for Laser Cutting & Engraving — Free](https://pngtosvgfree.com/png-to-svg-laser-cutting): Convert PNG images to laser-ready SVG paths for LightBurn, Glowforge and xTool. Single-colour silhouettes, clean closed shapes and speckle removal, free.
- [Transparent PNG to SVG — Keep the Background Clear](https://pngtosvgfree.com/transparent-png-to-svg): Convert transparent PNG images to SVG while keeping the background clear. Remove any solid background colour — free, no signup, private in your browser.
- [Black and White PNG to SVG — Line Art Converter](https://pngtosvgfree.com/black-and-white-png-to-svg): Convert black and white PNG images, line art, sketches and signatures to crisp two-tone SVG vectors. Free, no signup, private — processed in your browser.
- [GIF to SVG Converter — Free Online, No Upload](https://pngtosvgfree.com/gif-to-svg): Convert GIF images to SVG vectors free. Flat-colour GIF logos, icons and clip art trace cleanly into scalable paths, right in your browser with no signup.
- [BMP to SVG Converter — Free Online Vectorizer](https://pngtosvgfree.com/bmp-to-svg): Convert BMP bitmap images to SVG vectors free online. Trace logos, scans and drawings into clean scalable paths in your browser, with no upload or signup.
- [AVIF to SVG Converter — Free, Private, No Signup](https://pngtosvgfree.com/avif-to-svg): Convert AVIF images to SVG vectors free in your browser. Trace AVIF logos, icons and illustrations into scalable, editable paths with no upload or signup.
- [Photo to SVG Converter — Turn Pictures into Vectors](https://pngtosvgfree.com/photo-to-svg): Convert a photo or picture to SVG vector art free. Choose 12 to 32 colours for a stylised poster look, all traced privately in your browser with no signup.
- [Drawing to SVG — Convert Sketches to Vector Free](https://pngtosvgfree.com/drawing-to-svg): Convert a hand drawing, sketch or line art to SVG free. Trace pencil and ink drawings into clean, scalable vector lines in your browser, with no signup.
- [Bulk SVG to PNG Converter](https://pngtosvgfree.com/bulk-svg-to-png-converter): Convert many SVG files to high-resolution PNG at once. Choose 1x, 2x, 4x or an exact width, keep transparency and download all as ZIP. Free, private.
- [Free SVG Gallery](https://pngtosvgfree.com/gallery): Download free SVG illustrations for Cricut, Silhouette, web and print. Copy the code or save the file, recolour easily, and use in commercial projects.

## Key guides

- [How to Convert PNG to SVG (Free, 3 Methods)](https://pngtosvgfree.com/blog-convert-png-to-svg): Three free ways to convert PNG to SVG: an online tracer, Inkscape's Trace Bitmap and Illustrator Image Trace. Step-by-step instructions, settings and tips.
- [PNG vs SVG: Differences and When to Use Each](https://pngtosvgfree.com/blog-png-vs-svg): PNG and SVG both support transparency, but one is pixels and one is vectors. A practical comparison of quality, file size and editing to help you choose.
- [How to Make SVG Files for Cricut from Any Image](https://pngtosvgfree.com/blog-make-svg-for-cricut): To make a Cricut SVG from any image: trace it into layers, remove the background, upload to Design Space, then resize, weld and weed. Step-by-step guide.
- [How to Vectorize a Logo Without Illustrator](https://pngtosvgfree.com/blog-convert-logo-to-svg): Lost the original vector file of your logo? Learn how to turn a PNG or JPG logo into a clean, editable SVG in minutes, free and without Illustrator.
- [Raster vs Vector Images Explained](https://pngtosvgfree.com/blog-raster-vs-vector): Raster and vector are the two ways computers store images. Understand the difference once and you will always know which file format to use.
- [Best Settings for Clean SVG Tracing](https://pngtosvgfree.com/blog-best-svg-tracing-settings): The tracing settings that matter most: colours, detail, noise smoothing, speckle removal and corner angle, with recommended values for every image type.
